# 04 — Power & Thermal

Generation, storage and heat. Power parts drive the Attraction score (noise, light, output), so their audio and light sockets matter as much as their meshes.

**13 parts · 18 Blender assets.** Standards for every card are in [00 — Blender Modeling Standards](00-blender-modeling-standards.md).
